measuredInformedModel.meaning: Upper bound that keeps every run at its 0.40 USD cap (assumed) and replaces the onboarding and map caps with the AC-14 derived figures (measured, rounded up). It is still not a forecast: run cost is assumed, fast-mode onboarding is assumed no dearer than full-mode, and the parent-time knowledge corpus is assumed no larger than HEAD's (the 9-chunk cap bounds it).

aa-phan-portfolio-v2.basis: A = a map generation plus an onboarding of the repository that now carries the map (assumed, conservative); B derived; C measured

auto_search_workflow.basis: A has no map generation (parent carries a map) and reuses it (assumed); B derived; C measured
